name: Titanium
uses: Titanium dioxide pigment for paint, paper and plastics is the main use; titanium metal goes into aircraft, medical implants and chemical plant.
why_it_matters: Paraguay's Alto Paraná deposit is at pilot stage; included for the exploration record rather than for current trade.
uses_source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (annual; uses as summarised there) and the registry notes; curated text, no figures
